warmup: pnpm exec supabase start && pnpm exec supabase stop

supabase.cmd: pnpm exec supabase start && exec docker logs -f --since 1s supabase_db_app

web.cmd: timeout 600 sh -c 'until pnpm exec supabase status >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done' && eval "$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env --override-name api.url=SUPABASE_URL --override-name auth.anon_key=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY | sed 's/^/export /')" && exec pnpm dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000}
